title: Case IV: DB Has a Black Sibling Whose Far Child is Red

blocks.content: Case IV: DB Has a Black Sibling Whose Far Child is Red
Consider a DB that has a black sibling whose far child is red like this.

blocks.alt: DB Has a Black Sibling Whose Far Child is Red

items: Swap the color of the parent and the sibling of DB.
Rotate the parent in the direction of DB.
Change the DB to a single black node.
Change the color of the red far-child to black.

blocks.alt: Final Tree After Removing Double Black Node
